defaults.notes: Configured for a default osm2pgsql schema: planet_osm_point, planet_osm_line, planet_osm_polygon, planet_osm_roads. Source way geometries are EPSG:3857 and exports are transformed to EPSG:4326.

layers.name: countries
layers.description: Administrative level 2 polygons where present in osm2pgsql data.
layers.sql: SELECT osm_id::text AS id, name, admin_level, ST_Multi(ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Force2D(ST_Transform(ST_MakeValid(way), 4326)), 3))::geometry(MultiPolygon, 4326) AS geom FROM public.planet_osm_polygon WHERE way IS NOT NULL AND boundary = 'administrative' AND admin_level = '2' AND way && ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857) AND ST_Intersects(way, ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857))

layers.name: water
layers.description: Major OSM water polygons for low zoom context.
layers.sql: SELECT osm_id::text AS id, name, COALESCE(water, "natural", landuse) AS water_type, ST_Multi(ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Force2D(ST_Transform(ST_MakeValid(way), 4326)), 3))::geometry(MultiPolygon, 4326) AS geom FROM public.planet_osm_polygon WHERE way IS NOT NULL AND ("natural" = 'water' OR water IS NOT NULL OR landuse = 'reservoir') AND way && ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857) AND ST_Intersects(way, ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857))

layers.name: country_boundaries
layers.sql: SELECT osm_id::text AS id, name, admin_level, ST_Multi(ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Force2D(ST_Transform(ST_MakeValid(way), 4326)), 2))::geometry(MultiLineString, 4326) AS geom FROM public.planet_osm_line WHERE way IS NOT NULL AND boundary = 'administrative' AND admin_level = '2' AND way && ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857) AND ST_Intersects(way, ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857))

layers.name: major_cities
layers.sql: SELECT osm_id::text AS id, name, place, population, capital, CASE WHEN capital IN ('yes', '2') THEN 1 WHEN NULLIF(regexp_replace(population, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::bigint >= 1000000 THEN 2 WHEN NULLIF(regexp_replace(population, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::bigint >= 250000 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS rank, ST_Force2D(ST_Transform(way, 4326))::geometry(Point, 4326) AS geom FROM public.planet_osm_point WHERE way IS NOT NULL AND place IN ('city', 'town') AND (capital IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(regexp_replace(population, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::bigint >= 100000) AND way && ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857)

layers.name: major_roads
layers.sql: SELECT osm_id::text AS id, name, ref, highway AS road_class, ST_Multi(ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Force2D(ST_Transform(ST_MakeValid(way), 4326)), 2))::geometry(MultiLineString, 4326) AS geom FROM public.planet_osm_roads WHERE way IS NOT NULL AND highway IN ('motorway', 'trunk', 'primary') AND way && ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857) AND ST_Intersects(way, ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857))

basemap.description: Regional detailed OSM basemap for z6-z14.

layers.name: roads
layers.sql: SELECT osm_id::text AS id, name, ref, highway AS road_class, surface, oneway, bridge, tunnel, service, ST_Multi(ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Force2D(ST_Transform(ST_MakeValid(way), 4326)), 2))::geometry(MultiLineString, 4326) AS geom FROM public.planet_osm_line WHERE way IS NOT NULL AND highway IN ('motorway', 'trunk', 'primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'residential', 'unclassified', 'service', 'living_street') AND way && ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857) AND ST_Intersects(way, ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857))

layers.name: buildings
layers.sql: SELECT osm_id::text AS id, name, building AS building_type, "addr:housenumber" AS housenumber, ST_Multi(ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Force2D(ST_Transform(ST_MakeValid(way), 4326)), 3))::geometry(MultiPolygon, 4326) AS geom FROM public.planet_osm_polygon WHERE way IS NOT NULL AND building IS NOT NULL AND building <> 'no' AND way && ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857) AND ST_Intersects(way, ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857))

layers.name: water
layers.sql: SELECT osm_id::text AS id, name, COALESCE(water, "natural", waterway, landuse) AS water_type, ST_Multi(ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Force2D(ST_Transform(ST_MakeValid(way), 4326)), 3))::geometry(MultiPolygon, 4326) AS geom FROM public.planet_osm_polygon WHERE way IS NOT NULL AND ("natural" = 'water' OR water IS NOT NULL OR waterway IN ('riverbank', 'dock') OR landuse IN ('reservoir', 'basin')) AND way && ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857) AND ST_Intersects(way, ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857))

layers.name: landuse
layers.description: Regional OSM landuse and landcover polygons.
layers.sql: SELECT osm_id::text AS id, name, COALESCE(landuse, leisure, "natural") AS landuse_class, ST_Multi(ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Force2D(ST_Transform(ST_MakeValid(way), 4326)), 3))::geometry(MultiPolygon, 4326) AS geom FROM public.planet_osm_polygon WHERE way IS NOT NULL AND (landuse IS NOT NULL OR leisure IN ('park', 'garden', 'golf_course', 'stadium') OR "natural" IN ('wood', 'scrub', 'grassland', 'bare_rock', 'sand', 'desert')) AND way && ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857) AND ST_Intersects(way, ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857))

layers.name: boundaries
layers.sql: SELECT osm_id::text AS id, name, admin_level, boundary AS boundary_type, ST_Multi(ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Force2D(ST_Transform(ST_MakeValid(way), 4326)), 2))::geometry(MultiLineString, 4326) AS geom FROM public.planet_osm_line WHERE way IS NOT NULL AND boundary = 'administrative' AND NULLIF(admin_level, '')::int <= 6 AND way && ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857) AND ST_Intersects(way, ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857))

layers.name: places
layers.sql: SELECT osm_id::text AS id, name, place, population, capital, CASE WHEN capital IN ('yes', '2') THEN 1 WHEN place = 'city' THEN 2 WHEN place = 'town' THEN 3 WHEN place = 'village' THEN 4 WHEN place IN ('suburb', 'neighbourhood') THEN 5 ELSE 6 END AS rank, ST_Force2D(ST_Transform(way, 4326))::geometry(Point, 4326) AS geom FROM public.planet_osm_point WHERE way IS NOT NULL AND name IS NOT NULL AND place IN ('city', 'town', 'village', 'suburb', 'neighbourhood', 'hamlet', 'locality') AND way && ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857)

pois.description: Regional stable OSM POIs for z10-z16. Runtime status stays in the API.

layers.name: pois
layers.sql: SELECT osm_id::text AS id, name, COALESCE(amenity, shop, tourism, historic, leisure) AS category, amenity, shop, tourism, historic, leisure, brand, "addr:housenumber" AS housenumber, ST_Force2D(ST_Transform(way, 4326))::geometry(Point, 4326) AS geom FROM public.planet_osm_point WHERE way IS NOT NULL AND (amenity IN ('restaurant', 'cafe', 'fast_food', 'fuel', 'bank', 'pharmacy', 'hospital', 'school') OR shop IS NOT NULL OR tourism IN ('hotel', 'attraction', 'museum') OR historic IS NOT NULL OR leisure IN ('park', 'sports_centre')) AND way && ST_Transform(ST_MakeEnvelope({bbox}, 4326), 3857)
